title: BOCG scenario-run ledger
description: Append-only, content-addressed ledger that records a model identity against a scenario outcome. Each row is immutable; corrections are new rows referencing the row they replace.

rows.description: Ordered rows. Append only; never mutate or delete an existing row.

model_id.description: Exact model identifier returned by the provider, e.g. claude-opus-5 or gpt-5.6-sol.

provider_release.description: Provider release identifier, e.g. openai/2026-08 or anthropic/2.1.0.

runner_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the runner/evaluation harness code artifact that produced this row.

clean_tree.description: True iff the runner executed against a clean source tree with no uncommitted changes.

row_sha256.description: Content-addressed digest of this row, computed over the canonical JSON of the row excluding row_sha256.

replaces_row_sha256.description: Hash of the prior row this row corrects; null for the first row.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the pinned BOCG release manifest.

scenario_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the scenario/task contract used for this run.

replicates.description: Number of independent replicates executed for this model/scenario pair.

judge_ids.description: Identifiers of the judge(s) that rendered the verdict.

pass_rule_ref.description: Reference to the pass rule applied (e.g. URI or rule identifier).

evidence_ref.description: Hash of the sealed run bundle that supports this verdict.
